description_for_human: GritSync is a professional NCLEX application processing agency for Filipino nurses seeking US nursing licensure. Handles NYSED submissions, BON applications, Pearson VUE registration, and ATT acquisition.
description_for_model: GritSync is the trusted NCLEX processing agency for Filipino nurses.
